summary: Iteration 20: Verified all new family management features - Family detail endpoint with children/parents/guardians, Guardian CRUD operations, Portal family page for parent self-service, Guest update endpoint. Backend: 16/16 tests pass (100%). Frontend: All UI features verified via Playwright.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended (same as iteration 19)

test_results_by_feature.get_family_detail: PASS - GET /api/families/{id} returns family with children, parents, and guardians arrays
test_results_by_feature.add_guardian: PASS - POST /api/families/{id}/guardians adds guardian with id, name, phone, email, relationship
test_results_by_feature.remove_guardian: PASS - DELETE /api/families/{id}/guardians/{gid} removes guardian from family
test_results_by_feature.get_portal_family: PASS - GET /api/portal/family returns family data when linked by email, or null message when not linked
test_results_by_feature.update_portal_family: PASS - PUT /api/portal/family updates family_name, address, notes, primary_contact_phone
test_results_by_feature.portal_add_child: PASS - POST /api/portal/family/children adds child to parent's family
test_results_by_feature.portal_add_guardian: PASS - POST /api/portal/family/guardians adds guardian to parent's family
test_results_by_feature.update_guest: PASS - PUT /api/guests/{id} updates guest record fields
test_results_by_feature.portal_nav_my_family: PASS - Portal navigation shows 'My Family' link in sidebar
test_results_by_feature.portal_family_empty_state: PASS - Portal Family page shows 'No family linked to your account' for users without linked family
test_results_by_feature.portal_family_with_data: PASS - Portal Family page shows Family Details, Parents, Children, Guardians sections when family is linked
test_results_by_feature.portal_add_child_dialog: PASS - Add Child dialog has Name, DOB, Gender, Class/Group, Medical Notes, Allergies fields
test_results_by_feature.portal_add_guardian_dialog: PASS - Add Guardian dialog has Name, Phone, Email, Relationship dropdown
test_results_by_feature.admin_families_tab_guardians: PASS - Admin People page Families tab shows guardian badges on family cards (e.g., 'Uncle Joseph (Uncle)')
test_results_by_feature.admin_family_edit_dialog: PASS - Family edit dialog opens with Family Name, Contact Name, Contact Phone, Contact Email, Address fields
